name: Relation Verify → ID Pair
description: Map positive verification ($) to Chemical id | Disease id line.
process:
if state.get('result') == '$':
    hid = state.get('head_id') or ''
    tid = state.get('tail_id') or ''
    line = f"{hid} | {tid}" if hid and tid else ''
    __result__ = [line] if line else []
else:
    __result__ = []
